name: ES Auction Entropy Phase Transition v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: The opening auction can transition between directional disorder and order. Falling binary direction entropy indicates spontaneous coordination and persistence of the second-half directional majority. Rising entropy indicates coordination is dissolving, so the second-half majority should be faded.

signal.minute_state: +1 if one-minute close > open, -1 if close < open, and omitted if equal
signal.subsystem_entropy: binary Shannon entropy -p_up*ln(p_up)-p_down*ln(p_down), with 0*ln(0) defined as zero
signal.second_half_magnetization: count of +1 states minus count of -1 states
signal.ordered_transition: second-half entropy < first-half entropy; trade in the sign of second-half magnetization
signal.disordered_transition: second-half entropy > first-half entropy; trade opposite the sign of second-half magnetization
signal.zero_rule: no trade if either subsystem lacks nonzero states, entropies are equal, or second-half magnetization is zero
signal.interpretation: follow a system becoming more ordered and fade a system becoming more disordered

execution.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.stop_fill: one adverse ES tick beyond the applicable opening extreme
execution.entry_validity: skip if the frozen stop fill is not adverse to the simulated entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 10:00 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.gap_through_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the trigger, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick; otherwise fill at the frozen stop price
execution.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: The combined order/disorder state machine was profitable only because ordered transitions, shorts, and 2022 offset losing complements. Those subsets were revealed by the completed test and cannot be selected. The full preregistered entropy-transition hypothesis is temporally and directionally unstable.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: reversing the ordered or disordered transition direction
using close-to-close states, return magnitudes, volume weights, or more than two subsystems
adding an entropy-difference or magnetization threshold
weekday, volatility, volume, or regime filters
changing the stop or exit after observing results
